title: Elderly HealthMag: Systematic Building and Calibrating a Tool for Identifying and Evaluating Senior User Digital Health Software

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating digital health applications via cognitive walkthroughs using 'HealthMag' personas calibrated with health-specific facets (e.g., health self-efficacy, motivation, received care) to detect developer-assumption biases and inclusivity bugs.

Evaluating digital health applications via cognitive walkthroughs using 'Elderly AgeMag' personas calibrated with age-specific facets (e.g., visual impairment, physical difficulties, tech proficiency) to detect age-related interaction barriers.
